profile.note: This is an Auction-specific transformation specification, not an installed use4Goal importer. The existing .map parser maps iStar actors/elements to BPMN pools/nodes; it is not a JaCaMo-to-CSL XML rule engine.

M1 rules create only the finalized CSL declarations and its two role-population invariants. M0 rules specify an adapter contract for observed instances/state. Observer records are outside CSL. Configured instances and initial goals are expectations, not evidence of a live runtime object.

sources.note: Hashes identify the reviewed inputs. A changed hash requires re-audit before these case-specific rules are accepted; do not silently apply the profile to another Auction variant. Build caches, binaries and log output do not define M1 declarations.

formatContract.note: The regex selectors intentionally cover only the pinned simple JCM/ASL/Java fragments, not their general grammars. XPath os prefix is bound to http://moise.sourceforge.net/os. Traces use one-based source lines or Draw.io mxCell IDs.

operation.name: createClassifier
operation.meaning: Emit exactly one named OrgCtx, Role or Entity per selected row; owner denotes M1 declaration containment.

operation.name: createAttribute
operation.meaning: Emit a scalar property with explicit type/optional/mutable flags; omit absent default literals.

operation.name: mapObservable
operation.meaning: Match each selected observable to exactly one entry by sourceName and initialExpression; emit that entry as an Auction attribute.

operation.name: createPopulationInvariant
operation.meaning: Substitute source role id/min/max into the selected OCL template; size is a nonnegative collection size.

operation.name: upsertInstance
operation.meaning: M0 adapter operation keyed by runtime identity; not an M1 Entity or Association declaration.

operation.name: assignSnapshot
operation.meaning: Atomically assign actual source values from one coherent snapshot; never simulate operations to fill state.

operation.name: reconcileRemoval
operation.meaning: Remove only the identified projection after authoritative removal, or a complete authoritative enumeration; silence is not deletion.

rule.label: Role population bounds to domain-state invariants
rule.note: The [1..1] and [0..300] source bounds constrain M0 populations; they are not M1 containment multiplicities. Collection size is inherently >= 0, so the participant lower bound needs no extra conjunct. Do not discard violating snapshots.

rule.label: AuctionArtifact passive state to Auction Entity
rule.note: One M1 Entity type represents passive AuctionArtifact state. It is not one type per a1/a2, not a generic Artifact hierarchy, and not a claim that the organization physically owns its CArtAgO workspace. Scheme/Id correspondence determines model scope at M0.

trace.purpose: Scheme organizational scope and artifact creation by goal argument Id

rule.label: Artifact name to read-only Auction.id declaration
rule.note: id is the source artifact name bound from auction goal argument Id, not an AuctionArtifact observable or invented Java field. It is local to the run/workspace binding; native identity remains in the external runtime trace key.

trace.purpose: Id argument links the scheme to the named artifact

rule.label: Four observable properties to mutable scalar attributes
rule.note: Only initialization defaults are declared. Existing runtime objects must be read, never reset to defaults. best_bid has no CSL default because the source constant must not be replaced and the current CSL numeric grammar has no exponent literal. winner is an Atom-name String published by stop; it is not an Association to a Participant.

trace.purpose: Exact names, types, defaults and mutability

rule.label: Persistent internal candidate field to Auction.currentWinner
rule.note: The source already stores this value persistently. It is NOT an observable property. It changes only on a strictly improving bid and is later copied into winner by stop. Unavailable access means an incomplete snapshot, never a guessed value.

trace.purpose: Source-backed internal state in the finalized target

commonRequirements.note: All native identities are qualified by a fresh runId; workspaceUid and artifactUid identify the actual workspace and artifact incarnation. Never key an Auction by id/name alone across workspaces, disposal/recreation or MAS restarts. Sidecar keys are not extra CSL attributes.

Publish a full snapshot only when role membership, observables and currentWinner have a consistent source cut. Use operation boundaries or source-supported synchronization; notification receipt order and agent belief caches alone are insufficient. Incomplete/currentWinner-unavailable or stale snapshots cannot be accepted as a complete verification state.

Take actual runtime membership, including violations of the population invariants. Configuration is only the expected initial fixture; mission commitment is a separate observer fact and must not be substituted for a Role enactment.

conversions.note: For binary64 backends, preserve the raw finite Java value and round-trip bits; for mathematical Real backends decode its exact binary value. No finite-domain abstraction has been selected here. Double.MAX_VALUE is finite, not zero or infinity. String values such as no_winner remain scalar literals; no guessed Agent/Role link is resolved.

validation.note: The model rules are executed by an independent local validation harness. Generated .csl is compiled with the existing use4Goal compiler and compared with the target diagram embedded cslSource. Runtime tests use fabricated, source-faithful adapter records, not a live JaCaMo execution and not proof that the required observer exists.

limitations.limitation: This custom XML needs an implementation of the specified adapter/interpreter before production use; use4Goal has no native importer for it.
CSL core v4 parsing/semantic validation is supported; the current legacy runtime/CSL-to-USE backend explicitly rejects v4. These rules do not remove that boundary.
currentWinner cannot be obtained through the four observable properties. Direct field access or explicit instrumentation and a coherent state cut are required; this task changes no Auction code.
The existing OCL also needs operation signatures and the external AuctionMonitor/AuctionObligation verification view. CSL alone cannot compile/evaluate the entire OCL file.

An iStar organization viewpoint is not a CSL Role correspondence. Bind invocation self to Auction explicitly; the current models do not provide a total actor-to-Role mapping for a general conformance theorem.
No numeric bounded abstraction, Bid history, Service identity or winner-to-Role identity relation is assumed. Source-faithful projection may need backend support for Double.MAX_VALUE.
